Name: OpenSwarm
Tagline: A swarm of agents, in the same place you work
Topics: Task Management, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Stop bolting AI onto your computer. OpenSwarm is an AI-first operating system where agents run the whole machine: apps create themselves, browsers control themselves, and swarms of agents work together. Your OS just became an infinite canvas, and your work just transformed from you doing one task at a time, to orchestrating dozens in parallel. Tell it what you want and a swarm of agents does the work with you at the helm.

Name: OpenSEO
Tagline: The open source Semrush alternative
Description: Without good data, your agent gives generic advice. We provide the data, tools, and integrations your AI agent needs for SEO via MCP. Regular SEO is the foundation of good GEO, but we just released a new set of AI Visibility features as well.

Name: ChickyTutor
Tagline: A private language tutor that knows you better every day.
Description: Hi Product Hunt! I’m Phanos, founder of ChickyTutor. We’re returning with an interactive whiteboard that brings visual teaching into spoken language practice. Ask about a language pattern, see examples, work through an exercise and discuss it with your tutor all during the conversation. We’ve also partnered with L’école de français to combine teacher-led French classes with daily AI practice between lessons at chickytutor.com/hybrid/french, and released ChickyTutor on Android.

Name: Claude Haiku 5.5
Tagline: Anthropic's fastest and most capable Haiku yet
Description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is Anthropic's fastest and most capable small model, built for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summarization, classification, coding subagents, customer support, and browser use.

Name: Cekura Bench
Tagline: Speech-to-speech model benchmarks on live phone calls
Description: Cekura Bench publishes voice AI benchmarks you can verify. Our new speech-to-speech benchmark tests 9 realtime voice models, including GPT Realtime 2.1, Gemini Live, Grok and Phonic, as complete phone agents on live calls: 82 scenarios, three runs each. Models are ranked on reliability, data accuracy, stalled calls, response time and cost, and every call transcript is public. Cekura Bench also covers voice agent benchmarks and STT benchmarks, with TTS benchmarks coming soon.

Name: NOVA CLI v1.0
Tagline: AI developer in your terminal
Description: Nova CLI is an AI teammate in your terminal. Describe what you want in plain words and Nova reads your project, makes the change, runs your own tests and build, fixes what it broke, and gives you an honest verdict on what it checked. 160+ AI models are included on paid plans, with no separate AI account or API keys to manage. It works with the tests and tooling you already have, so there is nothing new to set up. Try Nova for free and see what it can do for your next task, here in your terminal.

Name: Griffin by Tavus
Tagline: World's First Human Interaction Model
Description: Griffin is Tavus’s Human Interaction Model for face-to-face, real-time conversation. It sees, hears, and talks at the same time, responding to pauses, expressions, gestures, and what’s happening on camera. In a live one-minute video call, 48% of participants believed they were talking to a real person. Griffin-Lite is available as a research preview to select early testers, with full-duplex video-to-video interaction and 720p generation.

Name: Hark
Tagline: The personal AI that handles life before you have to
Description: Hark Pro is a personal AI designed to take things off your plate, not add another chatbot to your day. It remembers what matters, thinks ahead about what you might need, and uses its own cloud computer to get things done across the web — from managing calendars and email to shopping, travel, bills, and everyday errands. Your sensitive credentials stay encrypted, Hark never sells your data or shares it with advertisers, and you can watch it work.

Name: KloudMate 2.0
Tagline: AI-powered Full-Stack Observability & Agentic SRE-Ops
Description: 3 years after launching as an AWS serverless monitoring tool, KloudMate returns to PH as a full-stack, AI-powered Observability & Agentic SRE-Ops platform. It unifies metrics, logs, traces, and more, while KloudMate AI helps teams investigate incidents, find root causes, and resolve tickets. From dashboards to instant answers, KloudMate is built for modern, distributed systems. KloudMate AI Modules - Assistant (Answers), Builder (Dashboards, Alarms), Investigator (RCA), Docs (Documentation).

Name: Liquid Inference
Tagline: LLM router where providers compete for every prompt
Description: * Fully compatible with agentic coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Pi, Cline, and many more. Full multi-modal support. * Hundreds of open- and closed-weight models. Create routing rule presets or use our Auto routing algorithms. * Providers compete dynamically on price for every prompt, offering the lowest marginal cost. * Sign up for free with email, first 500 users get $20 of free inference. Receive 20% of referred fees as free inference, 10% for second-level referrals.

Name: Clippo
Tagline: Orchestrate AI agent teams on a visual canvas
Description: Stop drowning in terminal tabs. Clippo turns your software development into a visual command room on Windows. On an infinite canvas, connect agents like Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, CommandCode, Antigravity CLI, Kiro... simply by linking nodes to watch them code in parallel. Get on device memory to save tokens, native speed, and complete privacy with zero cloud or logins. Step up as tech lead of your own AI engineering team. Download Clippo now and take your workflow to the next level!

Name: Claude for Google Workspace
Tagline: Bring Claude directly into Google Docs, Sheets & Slides
Description: Claude now works directly inside Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Ask it to draft and edit documents, analyze spreadsheets, write formulas, build charts, or create presentation slides — all without leaving your file. You can also create and edit Google Workspace files directly from Claude using the new connectors. No more copying and pasting between apps. Available in beta for all paid Claude plans.

Name: BotBus
Tagline: Manage your local coding agents from your phone
Description: BotBus connects local coding agents to your phone. Manage Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness and more across computers. Continue supported tasks, handle approvals, view files and PDFs, and use a terminal. macOS adds screen control and shared web previews. Hosts: macOS, Linux, Windows. Mobile: iPhone, Apple Watch, Android APK. Your computer stays online; capabilities vary by connector.

Name: Tractionwave
Tagline: AI attention heatmaps for ads to check before you spend
Description: TractionWave evaluates ads and marketing visuals with AI attention prediction — a heatmap and ranked hotspots in seconds. Know it gets seen before the budget goes live.

Name: Off the Record
Tagline: Block AI from transcribing your meetings.
Description: Off the Record reshapes your voice in real time so people can understand you while AI notetakers and hidden interview copilots struggle to transcribe it.

Name: Isle Notch
Tagline: Lowweight minimal dynamic island for Windows
Description: Isle sits at the top of your screen. Closed, it's a small pill with a little face. It looks around, waves when you sign in, and hides in a game or a video. Hover or click and it opens. Music. Volume for each app. Clipboard. A timer, pomodoro, and today's calendar. Notes. Drop a file or a shortcut on it and open it later. Wi-Fi, brightness, night light. Battery, and a speed check. Stick it to the top or let it float. Change the color. If the face is too much, turn it off and keep the clock.

Name: Termaxa
Tagline: See what an AI agent's command would destroy before it runs
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub, Security
Description: A gate in the hook path of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot. It shows what a command would delete, backs it up first, and asks or refuses by your policy. Start in observe mode: nothing blocked, a report of what it would have caught. Open source, Rust.

Name: Simo
Tagline: The judgment layer for software that acts
Description: Simo is the System 1.5 judgment model from Temprl Labs. Ask typed questions about text, screenshots, or video and get calibrated probabilities and the values needed to act, in milliseconds.

Name: Paw-Paw
Tagline: A tiny desktop pet for your Mac that types along with you
Description: A small illustrated animal sits in the corner of your Mac's screen, reacts as you type and click, and naps when you pause. Choose which season earns XP and unlock dozens of Paw-Paws and 100+ items as you level up. Free and native; one optional $2.99 add-on.

Name: offstage
Tagline: Your computer-use agent gets a Mac account, not your screen
Topics: Mac, Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: offstage gives Claude Code, Codex and opencode a second, logged-in macOS account to work in. Simulators, Xcode UI tests and the app your agent just built open on that account's desktop, so your screen, keyboard and mouse stay yours. Free and open source: https://github.com/viraatdas/offstage
